mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and corporate profit growth, directly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 7.0%, it signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based economic expansion across manufacturing and construction sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST rise month-over-month, or interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.15%), rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers further rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS > 0.15%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises quarter-over-quarter, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1050.0 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and economic confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1050.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.20% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.20%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising inflation that typically precedes interest rate hikes, reducing equity attractiveness and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
